newsitem.title: USA: Texas Utilities nuke power unit in restart.
newsitem.headline: Texas Utilities nuke power unit in restart.

text.p: Texas Utilities Co's 1,150 megawatt Comanche Peak nuclear power unit 1 was in restart mode Tuesday following a scheduled refueling outage, a company spokesman said Tuesday.
"It appears to be ramping up," said spokesman Jim Lawrence, adding the unit should synchronize to the electricity grid "in the next couple of days."
The Glen Rose, Texas unit was shut Oct 5 for scheduled refueling and maintenance.
The 1,150 megawatt Commanche Peak nuclear power unit 2 was operating normally at 100 percent of capacity as of early Tuesday, the spokesman said.
